changed_member_reviews.source_review: The historical eight supplied services/configuration slots remain on the owned abstract container. It composes public BasePortalOutlet and CdkPortalOutlet instead of inheriting current CdkDialogContainer constructor/private state. Local labelled-by queue and interaction state preserve historical bindings. The optional public CDK DialogContainer hooks are separately bridged without adding current private fields to the frozen legacy API.

Historical delayFocusTrap/autofocus/restoreFocus and interaction-origin behavior are owned over public focus services. Unstable first-tabbable focus retains a one-shot stability wait; late callbacks check destruction and preserve cleanup ownership. Destruction marks weak-map state dead before callbacks and nested finally blocks release subscriptions,trap and listener cleanup even if restoration throws. Native focus/shadow/zone behavior remains a separate gate.

Portal operations delegate to the real child outlet. Component/template attachment invokes post-attachment work only after success. DOM dispatch uses public attach and restores historical portal-host/attachment flags on failure before rethrowing. Availability rejects destroyed/occupied containers. Explicit detach/dispose forward to the child and public parent; the reading does not infer native view destruction or Angular node behavior.

Opening/closing/detachment subscriptions are owned,close is idempotent,notifications are one-shot,reentrant state changes are checked and missing/throwing motion still gets the historical cleanup margin. CLOSED state/subscription cleanup precede peer close;the component remains available through synchronous afterClosed then clears in finally. componentRef explicitly allows historical template undefined. Current nominal/subtype identity is deliberately not retained;using legacy reference types is the conservative consumer boundary,with no required DOM/CSS/SCSS migration. Native/API gates remain open.
